summary: Wave 3 end-to-end tested (promos scope/bogo, stock aged, PO extras, flash scope, promo-form bogo). Backend 6/6 pytest PASS. Frontend: all required data-testids present and functional. One UX nit: 'Visite guidée' tour modal (dashboard tour) opens on first entry per page and blocks interactions until manually closed (an X in top-right dismisses it) — affects usability for first-time testers but not a bug.

issues: 'Visite guidée · 1/7' onboarding tour modal appears on first visit per session and overlays the page, blocking clicks until dismissed. Testers (and users) must click the small X in the modal header to dismiss. Consider: (a) persist dismissal across pages, (b) make Escape key close it, (c) adopt a non-blocking spotlight overlay.
Hydration warning <span> cannot be a child of <option> from /app/frontend/src/components/shared/PeriodSelector.jsx line 96 — carried over from previous iterations, pre-existing noise.

action_items: (Optional) Make the 'Visite guidée' guided tour non-blocking or Escape-dismissible to improve UX and automated-testability.
(Optional, carried over) Clean up PeriodSelector <span>-in-<option> hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /stock/kpis `aged` computation uses `p.get('created_at') or now_iso()` — if a product has no created_at, the fallback becomes 'now' which is NOT < cutoff, so the product is correctly skipped (OK), but the same product WILL appear with age_days=0 in /stock/aged logic path only after age_days >= days threshold, so no false positives — behavior consistent.
server.py /stock/kpis counts `aged` as products created>60d ago AND not sold in last 60d AND stock>0 — matches /stock/aged default (days=60) ✓.
server.py line 2186 /promotions endpoint returns PromoIn fields intact (scope/products/category/buy_qty/get_qty/get_discount_pct) — verified via GET round-trip.
PurchaseOrders.jsx extras breakdown label is 'Coûts additionnels' (not 'Extras' literal) — matches spec wording from problem statement.
Promotions.jsx promo-form submit path: when scope=products with empty products[] a toast error is correctly surfaced (verified).
seed_data_creation: No lingering seed data — created a TESTBOGO_W3 promo and cleaned it up at end of test.
